definitions.explanation: A drawing that shows a three-dimensional object as seen straight on from one direction, as in technical drawing. In Japanese school mathematics it means the pair of a front view and a top view used to describe a solid.

examples.japanese: {投影図|とうえいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧{投影図|とうえいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: A projection seen from the front is called an elevation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投影図|とうえいず}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}いた→解く：02301_toku⟧。
examples.english: In math class we solved problems that asked for the volume of a solid from its projection drawings.

notes:
⟦{投影|とうえい}→投影：12854_touei⟧ (projection) + ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (drawing). Japanese junior-high geometry teaches it as two views drawn together: the ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧ above and the ⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧ below.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{平面図|へいめんず}→平面図：23670_heimenzu⟧: plan view; floor plan (seen from above)
- ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧: elevation (seen from the front or side)
- {正面図|しょうめんず}: front view
- ⟦{側面図|そくめんず}→側面図：23885_sokumenzu⟧: side view
